# Rome Pharma

> Rome Pharma helps international pharmaceutical companies enter the Turkish market via direct supply, government tenders, named patient programs and consulting.

Offices: Main Office (Çankaya / Ankara, Türkiye); Dubai Office (Dubai, U.A.E.); US Outreach Office (United States).

## Business lines

- Supplying pharmaceutical products for direct supply programs, government tenders and prescription-based programs (Named Patient Program)
- Consultancy and local representation for international companies planning to enter the Turkish pharmaceutical market
